title: The clear-shifts question appears only for the old lead's unfinished shifts
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the Work Orders build under test as a user whose role has Work Orders view and Work Orders create and edit. To check: Settings > Roles & Permissions > open the role > Work Orders (an Owner or Admin role has both).
  2. Use a desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide. Narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher.
  3. In the top bar, pick the location you will test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty") and stay in it for the whole case.
  4. At least 3 technicians are eligible at this location (e.g. "Esther Howard", "Ralph Edwards", "Dana Ortiz"). A staff member is eligible when Clockable is on, the staff record is Active, the role is neither Office nor Time Clock User, and they are enrolled at this location. To add one:
    • Settings > Staff > add a staff member, enter a first and last name (e.g. "Dana Ortiz") and an email.
    • Pick a role that is not Office or Time Clock User (e.g. "Technician"), turn Clockable on, keep the record Active, enrol the staff member at this location, then Save.
  5. Create a customer used only by this case so a search shows only its work orders: Customers > New Customer, name (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co"), add an asset with a unit number and year/make/model (e.g. unit "TRK-118", "2022 Freightliner M2"), then Save.
  6. Create six Approved work orders led by Esther Howard for the case customer, each with a line "Line 1": A (e.g. S1-701), B (S1-702), C (S1-703), D (S1-704), E (S1-705), F (S1-706).
  7. On the Schedule, give "Esther Howard" a shift on A tomorrow 8:00–12:00: Schedule > go to that day > drag the work order from the work order list onto Esther Howard's row at the start time > in the picker choose Entire work order > set the end time > save.
  8. B has no shifts at all.
  9. On the Schedule, give "Esther Howard" a shift on C tomorrow 8:00–12:00: Schedule > go to that day > drag the work order from the work order list onto Esther Howard's row at the start time > in the picker choose Choose lines and tick Line 1 > set the end time > save.
  10. On the Schedule, give "Esther Howard" a shift on D yesterday 8:00–12:00 (already ended): Schedule > go to that day > drag the work order from the work order list onto Esther Howard's row at the start time > in the picker choose Entire work order > set the end time > save.
  11. On the Schedule, give "Dana Ortiz" a shift on E tomorrow 8:00–12:00: Schedule > go to that day > drag the work order from the work order list onto Dana Ortiz's row at the start time > in the picker choose Entire work order > set the end time > save.
  12. On the Schedule, give "Esther Howard" a shift on a different work order (not F) tomorrow 13:00–15:00: Schedule > go to that day > drag the work order from the work order list onto Esther Howard's row at the start time > in the picker choose Entire work order > set the end time > save.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders, click the All tab and pick Board View in the display switcher (right side of the toolbar; in the design its button tooltip reads "Board").
  2. Type the case customer's name (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co") in Search.
  3. Drag A from Esther Howard's column into Ralph Edwards' column and note whether a prompt opens (if it does, click Keep shifts).
  4. Do the same, one at a time, for B, C, D, E and F.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Only A opens the "Clear Esther Howard's scheduled shifts?" prompt (1 of 6).
  • B (no shift), C (only a line shift), D (only an ended shift), E (only Dana Ortiz's shift) and F (Esther Howard's shift is on another work order) change lead straight away with "Lead technician updated" and no prompt (5 of 6).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10047 (Story 4, Reassign or unassign the lead technician); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S4-R28, read 8 Oct 2026. PO answer to engineering, Sasha Grosman 24 Sep 2026 (only the outgoing lead's whole-work-order shifts that haven't ended). Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R28: “The shift-clearing prompt (S4-R11, S4-R26) shows only when the outgoing lead has a work-order-level shift on this work order that has not ended.”
  • Tech plan §1.4 (FF-4 shift scope): “Confirmed: only the outgoing lead's whole-work-order shifts that have not ended”
